The '''Coruscant sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Planets in the sector included [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Metellos/Legends|Metellos]] and [[Utrost]]. The Coruscant sector was a subsector of the [[Corusca sector/Legends|Corusca sector]].

==History==
Under the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], it was called '''Imperial Sector''' and was part of [[Imperial Center Oversector]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the sector was governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kadir (Moff)|Kadir]]. It was defended by the [[Coruscant Sector Fleet]].
